summary: Delta fixes cover the reported data-preservation defects, but two new refusal/selection behaviours lack asserting regression tests. All 19 drop tests pass.

findings.summary: The inherited-run test does not verify authoritative-worktree filtering.
findings.evidence: ENG-1: The orphan fixture changes both its recorded worktree and branch. Removing is_authoritative from cmd_drop still leaves that fixture excluded by the branch check.
findings.fix: Add an earlier-sorting inherited state with the current branch but a different recorded worktree, and assert drop selects only the current worktree's authoritative run.

findings.summary: Refusal for an untracked design map has no asserting test.
findings.evidence: ENG-1: The new second status check refuses an existing untracked docs/design-code-map.json on a design run; no test asserts it.
findings.fix: Add a design-run test with an untracked canonical map and assert refusal leaves its bytes, git state, and archive unchanged.
